detail.longDescription: Understanding UiPath pricing should take three minutes. It doesn't. Take a few seconds to browse the website, and you'll find a mostly hidden pricing structure filled with attended bots, action center limits, and AI consumption units. If you want any further clarification, buckle in for a sales call.
